name: Delicious Meat Loaf
description: A classic meatloaf with a cheddar cheese and carrot mixture, topped with a sweet ketchup-mustard glaze.

recipeInstructions.text: Beat eggs in a bowl with a fork, then add milk, salt, pepper, and crumbled bread. Beat until the bread disintegrates.
Add chopped onion, shredded carrot, cheddar cheese, and ground beef to the bowl. Mix well.
Pack the mixture into a loaf pan.
Combine brown sugar, ketchup, and prepared mustard in a small bowl. Spread this glaze over the meatloaf.

keywords: meatloaf, cheddar cheese, ketchup glaze, classic American
